caption:
Two identical profiles. Different consulates. Different outcomes.

The rule: apply to the country where you will spend the most nights, or your first entry point if the split is even.

But consulates in the UAE do not behave identically — appointment availability, processing speed, and how they read a Dubai-resident profile all differ. Choosing correctly is not a shortcut. It is applying properly.
